name: mstack-codex-led-dev
description: Codex coordinator workflow where another installed vendor offered by mstack-vendors (claude) writes each phase of a plan folder, a list of issues, or one larger task while Codex briefs it, runs validation, reviews every phase, processes findings with mstack-receive-review, and commits only the exact accepted tree. Runs in Codex only.

interface.shortDescription: Have another installed vendor write each phase while Codex reviews and commits it.
interface.longDescription: Codex leads while another installed vendor offered by mstack-vendors (claude) writes each phase of a plan folder, a list of issues, or one larger task in an isolated copy. Codex validates, reviews every phase, processes findings with mstack-receive-review, commits only the exact accepted tree, and delivers one pull request with serialized CI. Runs in Codex only.
